lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC (Integrated Food Security Phase Classification) data on a monthly schedule across Guatemala in 2017. The spatial data represents food insecurity classifications aggregated by administrative unit and scenario, with collection dates and classification scales recorded for each observation period.
